name: Saltwall Covenant FC
description: Founded in direct protest of the IRONWALL LEAGUE's 2199 Chrome Mandate expansion, Saltwall Covenant FC competes in the PURIST CIRCUIT out of a reclaimed warehouse pitch in the lower Tier 2 Saltwall District. Every player signs the Covenant Pledge — a legally binding document attesting zero active augmentation, zero geneware modification, and no BCI performance enhancement during competition. Their 2207 PURIST CIRCUIT championship run drew the largest unaugmented sports audience in Meridian 88 history, briefly outselling neural streams of the augmented leagues.
story_hooks: A Tier 3 corporate talent scout approaches a Saltwall Covenant star with an offer that would require voluntary chrome installation — and a complete identity change.
Someone is systematically leaking players' medical records to augmented-league recruiters, and the club's internal investigation points toward a trusted coach.

A Shelf-born teenager with extraordinary natural athletic ability must choose between Saltwall Covenant's ethos and a HelixCorp augmented-league scholarship that would lift their entire family out of Tier 1.
